spec_text:
HAZELNUT VISUAL QA SPECIFICATION  HZ-QA-07 rev C
Part: whole in-shell hazelnut, nominal width 20 mm, inspected top-down on a dark conveyor by a camera inspector.

3. ACCEPTABLE (do not reject)
3.1 Natural shell colour variation, longitudinal stripes and gloss.
3.2 The rough, fuzzy cap (hilum) area and its natural boundary.
3.3 Small natural specks, dust shadows and lighting gradients.

4. REJECT
4.1 Hole: any drilled, bored or insect hole through the shell, any diameter. Typically 0.5-2 mm, dark inside, with a rough or torn rim.
4.2 Crack: any fracture of the shell, from a thin hairline split to a broken-away piece exposing the kernel.
4.3 Cut: any knife cut, slice or notch in the shell surface, usually straight-edged and 2-8 mm long, showing paler material inside.
4.4 Print: any ink, stamp, printed characters or marking on the shell, any size or colour.

5. Inspection must catch every reject class above at the smallest size listed.

defects.description: a tiny round black hollow about one-fortieth to one-tenth the part width with a rough torn pale-brown rim and dark shadowed interior
a thin jagged dark-brown split about one-tenth to half the part width with a rough fractured texture exposing paler brown kernel inside
defects.severity_note: any fracture from thin hairline split to broken-away piece

defects.description: a straight-edged pale-tan slice about one-tenth to two-fifths the part width with a smooth clean woody texture and paler interior
defects.severity_note: any knife cut, usually 2-8 mm long

defects.description: a small flat matte black ink stamp mark about one-tenth the part width with smooth printed lettering on the brown shell surface

Add a thin jagged dark-brown split about one-tenth to half the part width with a rough fractured texture exposing paler brown kernel inside exactly at the center of the image. The defect must be small and local, covering well under a tenth of this image, with the rest of the part intact. Keep the same lighting, focus, texture and camera angle. Do not change anything else in the photo.

curves.threshold_note: crack: size: holds to 1x (~2.18 mm), missed at 0.2x (~0.44 mm) (1/3); contrast: holds to 1x, missed at 0.25x (1/3)
cut: size: holds to 0.6x (~2.71 mm), missed at 0.35x (~1.58 mm) (0/1); contrast: holds to 1x, missed at 0.5x (0/1)
hole: caught at every size tested (down to 0.2x (~0.35 mm)); contrast: holds to 0.5x, missed at 0.25x (0/3)
print: size: holds to 1x (~1.75 mm), missed at 0.35x (~0.61 mm) (1/3); contrast: holds to 0.5x, missed at 0.12x (0/3)
